instruction: Please enable the 'Dim screen when inactive' feature and set it to activate after 2 minutes in the system settings.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);
